name: Tako
description: Premium live data from authoritative providers and web search in one call. Search returns cited charts and web results, and Tako also reports what data it holds on an entity or metric, fetches the rows or page text behind a result, and explores its data graph. Tako's Answer Agent, Company Agent, chart creation, and synthesized answers are opt-in; each skill below names the URL that turns it on.

oauth2.description: Web hosts (Claude.ai, ChatGPT) authenticate via the server's OAuth flow.

apiKey.description: CLI/desktop hosts pass a Tako API token from tako.com as a Bearer credential.

skills.name: Search Charts & Pull Data
skills.description: Search premium data from authoritative providers and the live web in one call. Data cards carry a headline value, named sources, and a chart; web results cover everything else. Tako's data is live: it carries the latest reported quarter, same-day market prices, and official releases as they publish. Parallelize it: split a broad or multi-part request into several narrow searches, one entity and metric each, and run them at once. For one synthesized answer instead of cards, call tako_search_advanced with `include_answer: true`. It's opt-in on /mcp via ?tools=search,available_data,contents,search_advanced (an allowlist that replaces the default listing, so name the defaults you rely on too).
examples: US CPI inflation rate
US core PCE inflation rate
Nvidia quarterly revenue
Intel vs Nvidia revenue

skills.name: See What Data Tako Has
skills.description: Find what structured data Tako holds on an entity or metric, the answer to any "what data is there on X?" question, including a metric's exact name to search for. Also use it to disambiguate names, and to confirm what data exists when a search comes back empty.
examples: What metrics does Tako have for Tesla?
Does Tako have data on the S&P 500?
What data does Tako track for core CPI?

skills.name: Fetch Source Contents
skills.description: Fetch the data rows behind a Tako card, or the text of a web page, when you need the underlying data to compute over, quote, or reason about. Only cards marked `exportable: true` have rows to fetch; web URLs always work.
examples: Get the CSV behind this Tako chart
Pull the full rows behind this card
Extract the text from this article

skills.name: Explore the Data Graph
skills.description: Explore what a node in Tako's data graph connects to: its metrics, the entities a metric covers, competitors, industry, index membership, and sources. Resolve a name to a node first with See What Data Tako Has.
examples: Which companies does NVIDIA compete with?
Which countries does Tako track GDP for?
What metrics does Tako track for Tesla?

skills.name: Answer Agent
skills.description: Run Tako's Answer Agent on a question that needs research rather than a lookup: ranking or screening by financial or economic metrics, aggregation, and multi-hop reasoning across many entities. It plans several searches across Tako's data and the web, and returns a cited answer with the charts it built. Opt-in on /mcp via ?tools=search,available_data,agent (an allowlist that replaces the default listing, so name the defaults you rely on too); listed by default at https://mcp.tako.com/mcp/chatgpt.
examples: Compare revenue per employee across the Mag 7
Which S&P 500 companies grew revenue over 20% last year?
Analyze the correlation between rates and housing starts

skills.name: Company Agent
skills.description: Run Tako's Company Agent on a question about which companies match registry facts, such as status, incorporation date, registered location, or industry, or to find a company's officers and directors. It returns a cited answer with the list cards it built. Opt-in on /mcp via ?tools=search,available_data,company_agent (an allowlist that replaces the default listing, so name the defaults you rely on too); listed by default at https://mcp.tako.com/mcp/chatgpt.
examples: Find active UK software companies incorporated in 2024 and registered in Manchester
Who are the current directors of Dyson Technology Limited?

skills.name: Visualize Your Data
skills.description: Create a Tako card directly from your own structured data — timeseries, bar, table, financial boxes, and more. The card auto-renders as an interactive chart. It PUBLISHES: the card is public and permanent, and anyone with the returned url can open it without signing in. Opt-in on /mcp via ?tools=search,visualize (an allowlist that replaces the default listing, so name the defaults you rely on too); listed by default at https://mcp.tako.com/mcp/chatgpt, the surface that serves the chart widget.
examples: Chart this monthly revenue: Jan 50k, Feb 62k, Mar 71k
Make a bar chart of sales by region from my data
Turn this income statement into a financial card
